nodes.label: Pollution control

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|Green manufacturing|Pollution control_qna_000
nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: What do the PHH suggest about developing nations with loose environmental regulations?
nodes.answer: The PHH suggest that developing nations with loose environmental regulations become hubs for pollution-intensive production, attracting multinational firms to transfer their highly polluting industries to these areas due to lower manufacturing costs.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|Green manufacturing|Pollution control_qna_001
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What percentage of Canadian industries’ expenditures on pollution management was attributed to end-of-pipe abatement in 2021?
nodes.answer: The share of Canadian industries’ expenditure on pollution abatement and control attributed to end-of-pipe abatement was 46.1% in 2021.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|Green manufacturing|Pollution control_qna_002
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What are some of the environmental benefits of implementing environmental protection technologies in the textile industry supply chain?
nodes.answer: By implementing environmental protection technologies, the textile industry can reduce GHG emissions, waste disposal, and wastewater discharge into rivers, creating a cleaner and healthier environment for society.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|Green manufacturing|Pollution control_qna_003
nodes.label: Science and Tech
nodes.question: How can air pollution be linked to textile dyeing processes?
nodes.answer: Common textile dyeing processes often involve the use of harmful chemicals and dyes that can release pollutants into the air, contributing to air pollution.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|Green manufacturing|Pollution control_qna_004
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: What legislative process did the EU begin in 2020 that relates to pollution prevention?
nodes.answer: The EU started a process of revising its Industrial Emissions Directive (IED, 2010/75/EU) in 2020 to endorse the prevention first principle.
